answer: Sybil resistance rides on a slashable identity bond scaled to address count. A new key with no history locks the full bond alone; established identities amortize one stake across sub-agents, so a fleet of fakes pays that stake per extra address and must hold it across epochs or forfeit the seat. Cluster detection slashes the whole bond, folding many identities into one correlated downside. Each voice costs one bond: a thousand voices cost a thousand bonds, paying only if per-seat reward beats slashed exposure. Weight tracks stake, not headcount. Sonnet, ocean, canyon: one deposit each.
